svg.text: Family 156: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine (as claimed)
Rank-one projectors of R^4 in the trace-one symmetric 4 x 4 matrices, Frobenius metric
Record dimension (log scale) and the claimed 9
Finite sets gave every record since 1993; the claimed
witness is the whole compact projector image of RP^3.
Checked on 5000 random pairs in R^4
28 rational pairs exactly. Set lives in R^9.
Rays up to sign: 4 of type (1,0,0,0), 12 of type (1,+-1,0,0),
8 of type (1,+-1,+-1,+-1). Colour = piece with no orthogonal pair.
gives the same bound 24/5. These 24 lines need 5 pieces;
the claim is that the full set of lines needs 11.
